Bootcamp Capability IDs.description: Exact Human Rebuild capability IDs this world is designed to falsify; generated only from the canonical capability router.

Bootcamp Status.description: Practice-world lifecycle independent of Studio/Odin submission state.

Certification Alignment.description: Current certification objectives/credentials this world reinforces. Use only supported mappings.

Certification Evidence Level.description: Granularity at which this world may be credited for certification learning.

Certification Objective Coverage.description: Exact certification objective/domain coverage supported by the current certification authority. Do not invent objective IDs.

Checklist URL.description: Canonical mandatory Odin Workflow Checklist used by this task.

Environment Review Gate.description: Checked only after the built starter environment has been inspected against the approved Goal and starter spec.

Human Transfer Test.description: What KyJahn must independently diagnose, implement, verify, or explain for this world to count as transfer practice.

Lane.description: Execution lane. Bootcamp tasks are practice only once rehearsed and must not later be submitted as a new Odin task.

Local Starter Gate.description: Checked only after the exact reviewed starter environment is present and readable on the recording Mac.

Next Skill Action.description: Smallest next practice action derived from reviewer evidence.

No-Solution-Leak Gate.description: Checked only after review confirms the starter environment does not contain the final repair/refactor, final required tests/fixture, completed deliverable, answer key, or recorder-visible AI/project admin leakage.

Operator Pack Evidence.description: Build PR/ref and concise evidence that the environment was reviewed and the operator pack was generated.

Operator Pack Status.description: Pre-recording operator pack generated only after the built starter environment has been inspected. READY means exact navigation, setup commands, verification commands, narration cues and branch points are documented without pre-solving the substantive task.

Pre-Record Gate.description: Must be checked only after every Before Recording checklist item has been verified for this exact task and recording setup.

Recording QA Gate.description: Must be checked only after During Recording validation and archive/video integrity checks pass for the exact attempt.

Review Bundle URL.description: Google Drive folder or file bundle containing practice recording artifacts for AI review.

Reviewer Notes.description: AI/human practice feedback against the derived Odin-style rubric.

Reviewer Score.description: Internal practice review score, 0-100. Never represent as Mercor/Odin reviewer score.

Reviewer Status.description: Bootcamp reviewer state; not an Odin/Mercor approval state.

Skill Gap Focus.description: Current Market-Derived Skill Gap Queue items targeted by this world.

Skills Practiced.description: Concrete human skills exercised by this world.

Submission Gate.description: Must be checked only after all required uploads/metadata/checklist fields are complete and Studio shows the submission transition/result.

Transfer Synced.description: Automation marks this only after reviewed attempt evidence has been routed into the certification/skill system.

Workflow Checklist Gate.description: Mandatory Odin workflow gate. PRE-RECORD PASS is required before TaskRecorder may start; POST-RECORD PASS is required before upload; SUBMISSION PASS is required before the task can be treated as submitted.
